summary: National Grid plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying a London Stock Exchange pre-close update ahead of its half-year results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, with results due 5 November 2026. The utility said regulated businesses performed in line with expectations and now expects full-year EPS growth slightly above its 13-15% guidance, driven by roughly GBP130 million of first-half one-off fair value gains from two capital market transactions in the NG Partners portfolio plus stronger interconnector performance. Net debt is seen broadly in line with full-year guidance after the Joulent investment. No special-situation transaction, board action, terms or advisor is disclosed; this is routine earnings guidance, so no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle arises.
